verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing describes background automations it runs for the user: keyword-based auto-routing of mail to teams, an "AI-powered inbox" that automatically sorts and routes mail, automated check deposits, and configurable Slack/email alerts on new mail. These are fixed, product-defined rules on marketing pages rather than a general automation builder the user configures for autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: user-definable automation workflows (custom triggers/actions, scheduling), documentation of how routing/deposit rules are configured and their limits, API-level control of automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
